# UiPath Honors 2026 Partner Award Winners at its FUSION Conference


September 23, 2026 8:45am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_77eccf3d1d32fed4c2a56356335cb327/uipath/news/2026-09-23_UiPath_Honors_2026_Partner_Award_Winners_at_its_470.pdf)


*Global partner winners recognized for pioneering agentic automation and advancing innovation across industries with the UiPath Platform™*


LAS VEGAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[UiPath](https://www.uipath.com/) , Inc. (NYSE: PATH), a leader in business orchestration and automation, today announced the winners of the UiPath 2026 Partner Awards at its global user conference,[UiPath FUSION 2026](https://www.uipath.com/events/fusion) . The awards recognize partners who use the UiPath Platform™ to unlock innovation at the speed of business while delivering the controls and compliance enterprise leaders demand. This year, the program garnered submissions from over 30 countries, sharing nearly 250 use cases across 6 industries, and 20+ departments, demonstrating the remarkable results and real-world impact that companies are making with agentic automation and orchestration.


The[UiPath Partner Network](https://www.uipath.com/partners?utm_source=bing&utm_medium=paid_search&utm_team=pdi&utm_team_geo=global&utm_campaign=US_Tier-1_ENG_Brand_T4_Head&utm_term=uipath%20partner-p-c-o&utm_content=84113048068525&gclid=e0a5ec85a5e9161966ba861f89903929&gclsrc=3p.ds&msclkid=e0a5ec85a5e9161966ba861f89903929) is a global ecosystem of elite professionals committed to deliver transformative outcomes to leading organizations. These partners are at the forefront of the agentic era, and work alongside UiPath to help shared customers operationalize AI through governed orchestration and automation. They connect intelligence to everyday operations, allowing organizations to scale intelligently without increasing operational risk and driving measurable business outcomes.


"Our partners are integral to our success. They work directly with customers, turning business orchestration and automation from a concept into something that works in the real world. They bring us the use cases, feedback, and hard questions that make our platform better," said Andrada Morar, Vice President of Global Ecosystem at UiPath. "Together, we take what's ambiguous and audacious and turn it into our customers' reality. We're excited to keep building with them as they help customers automate what used to feel impossible."


The UiPath 2026 Partner Award winners are:


**Category Awards**


- **Agentic Leadership Partner of the Year:** Honors a global partner defining the future of agentic automation through enterprise-scale innovation, thought leadership, and multi-region impact.


- Accenture


- **Strategic Solution Partner of the Year** : Recognizes a global partner that co-develops repeatable, vertical, or cross-industry UiPath-based solutions driving measurable customer transformation.


- Deloitte


- **Agentic Transformation Partner of the Year:** Recognizes partners pioneering agentic automation in their market through innovative use cases and measurable results.


- Ashling


- **Solution Excellence Partner of the Year:** Honors partners delivering high-impact, repeatable, and industry-aligned UiPath solutions or accelerators.


- Welcomely Enterprises Inc.


- **Breakthrough Innovation Partner of the Year:** Honors partners pushing boundaries and experimenting with bold, forward-thinking applications of agentic automation.


- Groundswell


- **Technical Excellence Partner of the Year:** Celebrates deep technical mastery of the UiPath platform through certifications, enablement, and advanced implementations.


- cronos automation


- **Automation for Good Partner of the Year:** Recognizes projects that apply UiPath technology to advance societal, environmental, or human impact.


- Linktera Robotics


**Industry Impact Awards** : Recognize the most compelling Agentic Automation stories within key industries.


- **Banking, Financial Services & Insurance Partner of the Year**


- Cognizant
- Greenlight Consulting


- **Healthcare & Life Sciences Partner of the Year**


- Genzeon Corporation


- **Manufacturing & Supply Chain Partner of the Year**


- PricewaterhouseCoopers Private Limited
- Roboyo AI


- **Public Sector Partner of the Year**


- Deloitte
- Indra Group


- **Retail & Consumer Partner of the Year**


- Centelli


**Agentic Testing Pioneer Award:** Recognizes partners that have demonstrated early adoption of agentic testing and innovative applications of UiPath Test Cloud.


- Global Agentic Testing Pioneer


- Accenture


- Americas Agentic Testing Pioneer


- TestingXperts


- International Agentic Testing Pioneer


- QualityKiosk Technologies Pvt Ltd


To learn more about the award-winning work of our partners with the UiPath Platform, visit:[https://www.uipath.com/partners/grow/partner-awards/winners](https://www.uipath.com/partners/grow/partner-awards/winners) .
